comment: Recall at top-k over a symbol queried by its own doc comment, on real code in this repository.
**The query set was written by the authors of the code, not by a reviewer.** A doc comment describes the
symbol that follows it, so the expected answer is read off the file rather than chosen - which is what "no recorded
**Comments that name their own symbol are excluded**, because those are lexical lookups wearing the clothes
of a description. What remains is the size of this measurement, and it is smaller on purpose.
**The semantic half is reported only with a backend named**, because the embedding backend here is
intermittent: one probe threw `Tokenizer not found` and later runs report `onnx`.

backend.reason: onnx: createFromPackage failed: Tokenizer not found: /Users/lambertyan/Workbuddy/2026-08-17-18-51-38/repos/code-analyzer/node_modules/.pnpm/@agentix-e+embed-code-node@0.1.1/node_modules/@agentix-e/embed-code-node/models/tokenizer.json · api: ZHIPU_API_KEY is not set
backend.note: the first figure is BM25 alone; the second had vectors registered on the same engine

withVectorsRegistered.note: only meaningful when `backend` is not `none` - with no embedder this is the lexical figure again
